In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the central banks of advanced financialized economies have been instrumental in the creation and perpetuation of the rentier economy and the rentier society that has come to characterize the world today.

the central bank policy of the past half century has contributed to the creation of a new age of rentier tranquility, and this has been the main factor in the emergence of the new age of deep uncertainty.

, in contrast to the time of The Age of Uncertainity, today we live in a new age, the age of deep uncertainty, which is characterized by the following: the age of deep financialization, the age of rentier tranquility, and the age of deep centralization of power.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the metamorphosis of monetary policy from the age of rentier tranquility to the new age of deep uncertainty has been a process of the central bank’s policy from being an agent for income redistribution in the age of uncertainty to becoming a tool for rentier tranquility in the new age of uncertainty.
central bank policy has been a key driver of macro performance in the last 50 years.
the central bank policy of the age of uncertainty has been replaced with that of the age of rentier tranquility, and now the central bank policy is entering a new age of deep uncertainty.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the metamorphosis of central bank policy from the age of rentier tranquility (the 1950s to the 1980s) to the new age of deep uncertainty (the 1990s to the present) has been a major contributing factor to the deterioration of macroeconomic performance.

the evolution of central bank policy in modern financialized economies is characterized by the metamorphosis from the age of rentier tranquility, which is characterized by a central bank policy of targeting the price stability of financial assets, to the new age of deep uncertainty, which is characterized in part by a central bank’s policy of targeting price stability of financial asset prices and also by a policy of targeting the stability of the real economy.

the metamorphosis of central bank policy from the age of rentier tranquility to the age of deep uncertainty is the result of the changing nature of the economy, which is in turn the consequence of the rise of finance in the economy.
